verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Vestd serves an llms.txt at https://www.vestd.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a product summary, so an agent can be pointed at it. Beyond that file, agent-oriented docs are thin: the markdown help probe (/help.md) returned 404, and the file's depth and coverage are not evidenced. Missing for 10: markdown or agent-oriented help docs, evidence that the llms.txt covers the product's features and help content in depth, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
